scripts.build:win: vite build && pkg . --targets node24-win-x64 --output dist/AphroArchive.exe --compress GZip
scripts.build:extension: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if(!(Test-Path dist)){New-Item -ItemType Directory dist | Out-Null}; Remove-Item dist/AphroArchive-firefox.zip,dist/AphroArchive-firefox.xpi -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Compress-Archive -Path 'browser-extension/*' -DestinationPath 'dist/AphroArchive-firefox.zip' -Force; Move-Item dist/AphroArchive-firefox.zip dist/AphroArchive-firefox.xpi -Force; Write-Host 'dist/AphroArchive-firefox.xpi written.'"
scripts.build:wrapper: npm run build:linux && npm run wrapper
scripts.create-wrapper:
echo '#!/bin/bash
# Creates an isolated network namespace to bypass proxy blocks
bwrap --dev-bind / / --unshare-net --die-with-parent /bin/bash -c "./AphroArchive & sleep 2 && x-www-browser http://127.0.0.1:3000"' > dist/AphroArchive-Tails.sh && chmod +x dist/AphroArchive-Tails.sh
